title: Afflelou — claimed by emperador
description:
FR · Retail & E-Commerce · Alain Afflelou is a leading European franchisor of optical and hearing aid products, founded in France in 1972. The company operates a robust network of over 1,500 stores across 20 countries, driven by aggressive marketing innovations like its famous "Tchin-Tchin" multi-pair offer.

Key Figures

• Network Revenue: €1.13 billion (TTC) for the fiscal year ending July 2025
• Corporate Revenue: €447.3
